statement: In their inspected source paths Cemu 29f2f1f native Wii provider, wiiuse e769bd7, Linux v6.12 hid-wiimote, SDL Wii HIDAPI and libogc Wiiuse 959871c do not request MotionPlus F7 readiness, write F1 challenge-type, or request challenge data at 0x50 before their own MP detection/report processing. This is evidence of non-requirement in specified consumer code, not absence of physical registers or evidence that Nintendo Wii games skip the challenge. libogc's WM_SET_REPORT 0x50 code is a different protocol constant from extension address 0x50.

applicability.revision: Pinned source-only MotionPlus consumer and community records; no physical external/early-integrated/TR unit tested
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Cemu provider 245-432,925-949; wiiuse motion_plus.c 42-225; Linux v6.12 core 411-567; SDL SDL_hidapi_wii.c 385-481,1206-1244; libogc 959871c motion_plus.c 20-124 and wiiuse_internal.h 67,108-120. Source-only; all lab plans not run.
